entries.note: CENTCOM disabled a cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman on 7 Nov, but I found no UKMTO report of any 7 Nov incident (ukmto.org blocked).
Congress in extraordinary session on 6 Nov designated Antonio Barrios vice-president (unanimous show of hands) after Alliana assumed the presidency; La Nacion and Ultima Hora also report his oath.
Okamura on 6 Nov spoke of abolishing fees as the red line, but I found no report addressing the 10% to 6% trigger specifically.
Found only increases announced 3-5 Nov (KB, mBank); no new increase dated 6-7 Nov located.
Cenovy vestnik 119/2026 sets diesel max at CZK 47.28/l for 7-9 Nov, below 47.91 for 6 Nov (vestnik 118/2026).
CT24 reports the Chamber postponed the Ukrainian temporary-protection tightening bill on 6 Nov; 7 Nov was a Saturday with no vote found.
Israel Hayom (7 Nov) says Herzog held separate meetings with Eisenkot and Netanyahu before announcing his decision on Saturday 7 Nov evening.
